summary.text: Ray Peeples is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 14 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an information technology professional.

paragraphs.text: Ray Peeples was born in Buffalo, New York, earned a high school diploma from Lancaster Center High School, and attended Daniel Webster College, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an information technology professional.
He first took office representing Hillsborough 14 on December 4, 2024.
